dog.description_text: Hi, I’m Rose! I’m a two year old female cat. I'm a bit shy, but I’m a super sweet gal and I’ll gladly lean into pets whenever they’re offered! I’m still settling in to shelter life—I’m often curled up in my little house, since I know it’s safe. But I’m getting braver each day and starting to venture out and play! I’m learning how to play with wand toys, but I prefer the sound and crunch of a crinkly toy better. I think those are my favorite, but I’m still figuring it out day by day, so I’ll let you know if that changes. If you have a bit of patience and want a sweet, quiet cat, then I’m your girl! Adopt me today!
dog.name: Rose
